name: Bomana War Cemetery
reason: Three counted sources; CWGC cemetery, 3,824 graves, free, open 9am-4pm, a standard stop on Kokoda history tours.

name: Kerema
reason: Three counted sources incl. its own Wikivoyage page; the Gulf Province capital and the only base in Gulf, with hotels; a harbour/town stop at low rank.

name: Kokoda Track
reason: Three counted sources; headline WWII trek from Owers' Corner. Northern half is Oro: flag as a duplicate of the Oro entry, keep one.

name: National Parliament of Papua New Guinea
reason: Three counted sources; haus tambaran landmark with gardens and guided tours outside sitting days, so more than exterior only.

name: Port Moresby Golf Club
reason: One source; a private club course and restaurant, plain venue (rule 2), not a visitor draw.
